nodes.summary: The claim of Kourovka Problem 18.48 holds: the set of positive integers $k$ such that $\sigma\tau$ has order $k$ for some class transpositions $\sigma$ and $\tau$ of $\mathbb{Z}$ is finite.
nodes.title: Products of two class transpositions have only finitely many orders

nodes.summary: Only finitely many positive integers occur as orders of products $\sigma\tau$ of two class transpositions $\sigma$ and $\tau$ of $\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Claim of Kourovka Problem 18.48

nodes.summary: For integers $r_1, m_1, r_2, m_2$, write $r_1(m_1) = r_1 + m_1\mathbb{Z}$ and $r_2(m_2) = r_2 + m_2\mathbb{Z}$ for the residue classes. A permutation $\sigma$ of $\mathbb{Z}$ is the class transposition $\tau_{r_1(m_1), r_2(m_2)}$ when $0 \le r_1 < m_1$ and $0 \le r_2 < m_2$, the residue classes $r_1(m_1)$ and $r_2(m_2)$ are disjoint, $\sigma$ interchanges $r_1 + k m_1$ and $r_2 + k m_2$ for every integer $k$, and…
nodes.title: Class transposition of two residue classes

nodes.summary: A permutation $\sigma$ of $\mathbb{Z}$ is a class transposition when it is the class transposition $\tau_{r_1(m_1), r_2(m_2)}$ for some integers $r_1, m_1, r_2, m_2$.
nodes.title: Class transpositions of the integers

nodes.summary: For integers $r$ and $m$, the residue class $r(m)$ is the set $\{x \in \mathbb{Z} : x \equiv r \pmod{m}\} = \{r + k m : k \in \mathbb{Z}\}$.
nodes.title: Residue class

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
